mapper.select: select p.post_id as postId from sys_post p left join sys_user_post up on up.post_id = p.post_id where up.user_id = #{userId}

select p.post_id as postId, p.post_name as postName, p.post_code as postCode from sys_post p left join sys_user_post up on up.post_id = p.post_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = up.user_id where u.user_name = #{userName}
